summary.goal: Render attention-based sections on the plans list page with clear visual hierarchy and action affordances.
summary.context: The plans page transforms from a flat list to a prioritized dashboard. 'Needs Attention' surfaces actionable items at top. 'Working On' shows active work. Visual design follows relay-dashboard patterns with mission control aesthetic.

acceptance_criteria.description: Needs Attention section appears at top when plans need action
Each attention type shows distinct icon, label, and count
Attention items show time context (e.g., 'submitted 2h ago', 'stale for 14 days')
Working On section shows drafts updated recently and running executions
Sections are collapsible with remembered state
Empty Needs Attention shows celebratory message ('All caught up')
Visual priority: glow/accent on urgent items (failed, change_request)

steps.title: Verify ui-attention-signals dependency is ready
steps.description:
This feature depends on ui-attention-signals being implemented. Before starting, verify:
1. PlanSummary type includes attention_types?: AttentionType[]
2. AttentionType enum exists in types with values: awaiting_approval, change_request, gate_pending, execution_failed, unread_comments, stale_draft, active, none
3. listPlans API returns attention data when called

If not implemented, this feature is blocked.

steps.title: Create AttentionBadge component
steps.description:
Component that renders icon + label for each attention type with appropriate color scheme.

Create packages/planner-ui/src/components/AttentionBadge.tsx:

Props:
- type: AttentionType
- variant: 'compact' | 'full' (default 'full')
- className?: string

Color mapping (using CSS variables):
- awaiting_approval: bg-warning/10 text-warning (orange)
- change_request: bg-accent-purple/10 text-accent-purple (purple)
- gate_pending: bg-warning/10 text-warning (orange)
- execution_failed: bg-error/10 text-error (red) + shadow-glow effect
- stale_draft: bg-bg-tertiary text-text-muted (muted gray)
- active: bg-accent-cyan/10 text-accent-cyan (cyan)
- unread_comments: bg-accent-cyan/10 text-accent-cyan (cyan)

Compact mode: icon only (16px). Full mode: icon + label text.

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders correct icon for each AttentionType using icons from i001

steps.title: Create CollapsibleSection component
steps.description:
Reusable section with header, count badge, collapse toggle, and content area.

Create packages/planner-ui/src/components/CollapsibleSection.tsx:

Props:
- sectionId: string (for localStorage key)
- title: string
- count?: number
- accentColor?: 'warning' | 'error' | 'cyan' | 'green' | 'muted' (for glow effect when count > 0)
- defaultCollapsed?: boolean
- hideWhenEmpty?: boolean
- children: ReactNode
- emptyState?: ReactNode (shown when no children and not hideWhenEmpty)

Behavior:
- Click header to toggle collapsed state
- Store collapsed state in localStorage as `section-collapsed-{sectionId}`
- Collapse animation: max-height transition (200ms ease)
- ChevronIcon rotates on collapse
- Count badge appears next to title when count > 0
- When accentColor provided and count > 0, header has subtle glow

acceptance_criteria.description: Header shows title and count badge when count > 0
Clicking header toggles collapsed state
ChevronIcon rotates smoothly (transform: rotate)
Collapsed state persists in localStorage as 'section-collapsed-{sectionId}'
Content animates with max-height transition (200ms)
hideWhenEmpty=true hides entire section when no children
emptyState shown when no children and not hidden

steps.title: Create NeedsAttentionSection component
steps.description:
Groups plans by attention type, showing most urgent items first.

Create packages/planner-ui/src/components/NeedsAttentionSection.tsx:

Props:
- plans: PlanSummary[] (filtered to those with attention needs)

Behavior:
1. Filter out plans with attention_types = ['none'] or ['active']
2. Group by primary attention type (attention_types[0])
3. Sort groups by urgency: execution_failed > change_request > gate_pending > awaiting_approval > stale_draft > unread_comments
4. Within each group, sort by updated_at (most recent first)

Layout:
- Uses CollapsibleSection with title 'Needs Attention' and accentColor based on highest urgency
- Each group: heading with icon + label + count (e.g., 'Failed Executions (2)')
- AttentionItems under each group heading
- Empty state: CheckIcon with 'All caught up!' message in success/green accent

acceptance_criteria.description: Groups plans by attention_types[0] (primary attention)
Groups sorted: execution_failed > change_request > gate_pending > awaiting_approval > stale_draft > unread_comments
Each group shows icon, label, and count
Plans within group sorted by updated_at descending
Empty state shows CheckIcon + 'All caught up!' with success accent
Uses CollapsibleSection with sectionId='needs-attention'

steps.title: Create WorkingOnSection component
steps.description:
Shows user's active work: drafts updated recently and running executions.

Create packages/planner-ui/src/components/WorkingOnSection.tsx:

Props:
- plans: PlanSummary[] (filtered to those with 'active' attention type)

Behavior:
1. Filter to plans where attention_types includes 'active'
2. Sort by updated_at descending (most recently touched first)
3. Hide section entirely if no active plans (hideWhenEmpty=true)

Layout:
- Uses CollapsibleSection with title 'Working On' and accentColor='cyan'
- AttentionItems showing plan goal + 'Last edited X ago' or 'Running' for executions
- Simpler than NeedsAttention - no grouping, just a list

Uses CollapsibleSection with sectionId='working-on' and hideWhenEmpty=true
